capabilities: Preview Markdown files as Marp slide decks
Export slides to PDF, PPTX, or HTML via npx
Embed local images as Base64 using wikilink or CommonMark syntax
Load custom Marp themes from a CSS theme folder
extras: Exports always go to the Downloads directory. HTML transitions require the viewTransition API enabled in Chrome 110 (not needed in Chrome 111+). Obsidian must be restarted after adding theme CSS files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author Marp-format slide decks from notes or export them as presentation files.

relations.evidence: Plugin to use Marp with Obsidian.md.

summary: Marp integration that renders Markdown notes as slide decks with live preview and exports them to PDF, PPTX, and HTML.
